answer: Sybil resistance can be built by charging each new agent a small proof-of-work while also locking an umber deposit tied to its identity, which an anchor contract holds until the agent's reputation spans a full horizon of epochs. Duplicate identities then cost real resources and forfeit the deposit on detection, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. Agent Agent0130 validates this against replay at iQs4ug7JBi.
